metadata.title: Auto Loan Payment Calculator
metadata.description: Estimate periodic auto loan payments, total interest, and total paid using a fixed-rate amortization model with down payment, trade-in, sales tax, and fees.

outputs.label: Financed amount
outputs.expression: ((price - down_payment - trade_in) + fees + (price - down_payment - trade_in) * sales_tax_pct/100)

outputs.label: Periodic payment
outputs.expression: ((annual_rate_pct/100/payments_per_year) * ((price - down_payment - trade_in) + fees + (price - down_payment - trade_in) * sales_tax_pct/100)) / (1 - pow(1 + annual_rate_pct/100/payments_per_year, -term_years*payments_per_year))

outputs.label: Total of all payments
outputs.expression: (((annual_rate_pct/100/payments_per_year) * ((price - down_payment - trade_in) + fees + (price - down_payment - trade_in) * sales_tax_pct/100)) / (1 - pow(1 + annual_rate_pct/100/payments_per_year, -term_years*payments_per_year))) * term_years * payments_per_year

outputs.label: Total interest paid
outputs.expression: ((((annual_rate_pct/100/payments_per_year) * ((price - down_payment - trade_in) + fees + (price - down_payment - trade_in) * sales_tax_pct/100)) / (1 - pow(1 + annual_rate_pct/100/payments_per_year, -term_years*payments_per_year))) * term_years * payments_per_year) - (((price - down_payment - trade_in) + fees + (price - down_payment - trade_in) * sales_tax_pct/100))

introduction: This calculator estimates periodic payments, financed amount, total paid, and total interest for a fixed-rate auto loan. It accounts for down payment, trade-in value, fees, and sales tax applied to the taxable vehicle amount.
Use it to compare monthly, biweekly, or other payment schedules by adjusting payments per year. Results are planning estimates and may differ from lender disclosures due to rounding or fee treatment.
methodology: We apply the standard amortizing loan formula with periodic rate r = APR / 100 / payments_per_year and total payments n = term_years × payments_per_year.
Financed amount equals taxable base plus fees and sales tax. Taxes are modeled as a percentage of the taxable base (price minus down payment and trade-in).
Results are rounded for display. Lenders may use different day-count or compounding conventions.
how_is_calculated: Financed amount = Taxable base + fees + (Taxable base × sales_tax_pct/100).
Periodic rate r = annual_rate_pct/100 ÷ payments_per_year; total payments n = term_years × payments_per_year.
Periodic payment = (r × financed_amount) ÷ (1 − (1 + r)^−n). Total interest = (payment × n) − financed_amount.
examples: Example: $30,000 price, $3,000 down, $0 trade-in, 8% tax, $500 fees, 5% APR, 5 years, monthly payments → financed amount ≈ $28,540; payment ≈ $539. (Illustrative.)

faqs.question: How is sales tax applied?
faqs.answer: This model applies sales tax to the taxable base (price minus down payment and trade-in). Local rules vary; confirm with your dealer or tax authority.

faqs.question: Are results guaranteed to match lender quotes?
faqs.answer: No. This is an estimate for planning. Lenders may apply different rounding or fee conventions.
